facts.text: create_gensim builds a SapienEnv with create_sapien
create_gensim instantiates the named task class and returns GenSimTaskWrapper
The factory's __main__ example calls create_gensim with TurnOnFaucet and a second argument Sapien
GenSimTaskWrapper delegates reset(random) to task.reset(random)
GenSimTaskWrapper.step calls task.env.step and returns obs, reward, done, info (the legacy four-value Gym tuple)
The reward is task.get_reward(); an exception in that call is replaced by reward 0
The wrapper sets done when the task reports success (unless whole_eps) and calls reset_internal when done
The environment step calls step_action, sim_step, get_observation, is_done and get_info and returns obs, done, info
is_done is current_step >= horizon
horizon is 50 control steps and action_dim is 8
The action space is Box(low=-1, high=1, shape=(action_dim,))
The simulator sets _sim_freq=100, _sim_steps_per_control=80 and dt=_sim_steps_per_control/_sim_freq
sim_step executes _sim_steps_per_control scene steps and increments current_step once
The state observation is 15 float32 values: end-effector position (3), end-effector quaternion (4) and the first 8 joint positions
The action's first three values are the target end-effector position, elements 3:7 are the quaternion for an eight-value action, and the last value is the gripper command
Seeding replaces the environment's np_random generator and returns [seed]
The wrapper's seed delegates to task.env.seed
The wrapper's close delegates to task.close
GenSimBaseEnv subclasses gym.Env
set_gripper writes int(openness) * 0.04 as the target of each of the last two active joints
GenSimBaseTask.reset_objects prints the selected Asset ID

determinism.notes: the standalone fake seed() controls its placeholder generator, but native reset accepts only random=False. The bridge's legacy fallback calls seed(seed), then reset() and discards options; protocol resets use the default placeholder pose. This is not a claim of reproducible randomized resets in the upstream tasks

gaps: kinematic stand-in: the end-effector moves a fixed fraction toward the commanded pose and no forces, contacts, planning, collisions or dynamics are simulated
the start pose, target pose, joint values and move fraction are placeholders, not values read from an upstream task or asset
no camera, point cloud, depth, renderer or image observation is produced; the state observation is the only observation mode
the task progress, reward and all_done flags are a one-stage reach model, not the multi-stage success criteria of the upstream tasks
the upstream planner's per-control path can execute additional physics steps, so one upstream control step is not exactly the declared 800 ms; the fake advances one fixed 800 ms control step
the fake reset signature matches wrappers.py:112: options['random'] is ignored by the bridge's legacy fallback; the earlier fake-only seeded random-reset behavior was not an upstream behavior

fake close only marks the stand-in closed; the real wrapper calls task.close (wrappers.py:127-128), which the shipped task/base classes do not implement. A lifecycle adapter is required before the declared sim backend can be accepted

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the software latch refuses further step, reset and seed calls until mhs.safety.reset; cached world state stays readable and latch reset advances nothing; the latch does not interrupt an in-flight SAPIEN planner or certify a native stop; no hardware path is served
